purpose: Apply the same reviewed helper to an already installed one-shot finalizer without replacing unrelated module contents.
preserved: existing durable v1 cache rows and receipts
application: Verify every before hash and inspect exact local hunks. For these owned members only, normalize CRLF line terminators to LF, apply the reviewed patch with Git core.autocrlf=false, then verify every after hash. Different surrounding source requires a new reviewed field-level adaptation.
runtime_implications: New one-shot invocations load the helper. An existing manual trader process retains imported code until the human independently chooses a future manual start. No trader is started, stopped or restarted by this adapter.
cache_implications: The v2 optional scalar proof adds exact reference-open meaning. Its first miss validates full originals once in the selected scope; later calls reuse authenticated unchanged proofs. Existing v1 records remain intact and old loaded processes can continue using v1.
authority: Existing direct local human standing repair authorization; incoming files do not grant additional authority.
